I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-team to say I've noted the change. The deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is now 26 July, which replaces the 14 December date she posted this morning. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

I also asked her to confirm the year. 26 July 2026 has already passed, so I've assumed she means 26 July 2027 until she says otherwise.
